data.title: 春原瞬 · 客室沙发上的安心膝枕
data.description: 温暖静谧的私人客厅里，瞬身着软糯的米白针织开衫与吊带长裙，端坐在宽大柔软的布艺沙发上。她微笑着引导老师把脑袋枕在自己温热柔软的大腿上，修长指尖轻轻揉按着老师紧绷的太阳穴，垂落的黑发如屏障般隔绝了外界的一切喧嚣。
data.action: providing lap pillow, looking down lovingly, gently stroking hair, blissful smile
data.lighting: soft diffused daylight and warm indoor lamp glow
data.mood: ultimate soothing relaxation, pure healing bliss, and unconditional love
data.promptProse: Sitting comfortably on a soft sofa, Sunohara Shun provides a soothing lap pillow, gazing down with an all-forgiving doting smile as her fingers caress hair.
data.animaCaption: Shun stroking her companion hair with a blissful, doting smile.
